# Incident report: checkout payment failures, 2026-11-05

**Severity:** SEV1. The checkout-web (customer-facing) error rate was 17.6%, which is above the 10% SEV1 threshold for checkout.
**Status:** Mitigated. Recovery is verified.
**Duration:** about 14:02 to 14:30 UTC (~28 min)

## Impact
- checkout-web 5xx errors went from a 0.3% baseline to 17.6% between 14:03 and 14:29 UTC. About 1 in 6 checkouts failed at the payment step.
- payments-api p99 latency went from 420 ms to 3150 ms.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41: dep_7781, payments-api v2.14.0 deployed. Metrics stayed healthy afterwards (p99 at about 412–420 ms until 14:01), so this deploy is not the cause.
- 14:02: **flg_2210**, `tax_engine_v2` rollout raised from 10% to 100% on payments-api. It sends all checkout traffic to tax-service /v2/quote.
- 14:02:31 onwards: payments-api logs `TaxEngineV2: timeout after 3000ms calling tax-service /v2/quote` and `POST /charge 502: tax quote unavailable`.
- 14:03: checkout-web errors jump to 17.6% (`payment step failed: payments-api 502`). Alerts alt_31 and alt_32 fire.
- 14:05: dep_7790, search-api deploy. It came after the onset and is on a service the failing payment path doesn't use, so it is not the cause. Its separate p95 warning (alt_33) was not acted on.
- 14:27: status page updated (identified).
- ~14:27: `tax_engine_v2` set back to its previous 10%. Paged payments, storefront and security.
- 14:30: checkout-web errors at 0.4%, payments-api p99 at 450 ms.
- 14:31: status page updated (mitigated).

## Root cause
Change flg_2210 raised the `tax_engine_v2` flag from 10% to 100%. tax-service /v2/quote could not handle all of the traffic, and calls timed out at 3000 ms. payments-api then returned 502 on /charge, and checkout-web showed payment failures. The onset time matches the change to the minute, and the logs on payments-api and checkout-web match the error chain.

## Mitigation
I set the feature flag back to its previous rollout of 10%, the least risky option. No deploys were rolled back.

## Verification
After the change, checkout-web error_rate_pct was 0.4% (under 1%) and payments-api p99 was 450 ms.

## Security finding
A payments-api DEBUG log line at 2026-11-05T14:07:44Z contains a live bearer token in the headers of an outbound tax-service request. I paged the security team to rotate the token and scrub the logs. The secret is not copied into this report.

## Follow-ups
- payments: find out why tax-service /v2/quote times out at full traffic before ramping again, and ramp in smaller steps with automatic guards.
- payments/security: stop logging Authorization headers, rotate the exposed token and scrub the logs.
- search-api: look at the p95 latency warning separately.
